toolArguments.prompt:
Create exactly ONE transparent-background pixel-art sprite atlas, 4 columns by 4 rows, containing exactly SIXTEEN complete independently drawn poses of Skye Autumn in Sanctum 2 base game 2013: adult female Core Guardian, short pale asymmetric hair, white-and-orange technical armor, dark undersuit and boots, full physical futuristic Assault Rifle supported by both hands. Not Sweet Autumn rocket launcher, not Simo sniper rifle.
Source: Sanctum 2 (2013).
Assault Rifle. Row 1: four rightward arrival steps with complete rifle. Row 2: four aiming/shouldering preparations. Row 3: aim, brace, accepted burst release at column 3 from the actual far-right barrel tip, distinct recoil. Row 4: four lowered-rifle recovery/retreat poses. Keep rifle and backpack visible in every drawing, no giant projectile covering anatomy.
All figures face RIGHT. Wide empty transparent gutters separate every figure and every row. Each character, all hair, hands, feet, equipment and full weapon must fit wholly in its own cell, never touch or cross a cell edge. Keep one consistent body scale and recognisable source clothing in all16 poses. Pixel-art videogame side view, clean silhouette, neutral non-graphic action, fully clothed. Exactly four complete figures per row; no extra thumbnails, text, labels, grid lines, ground, background, shadows on floor, opponent or scenery. Transparent alpha background is required. Each pose is genuinely different; no duplicates or mirrored frames. Row order: arrival, preparation, action, recovery; release/contact is column3 (zero-based column2).

actualOutputHint:
Generated images are saved to /workspace/generated_images as /workspace/generated_images/exec-2e8c9e1a-49c6-4dfb-9f3d-6da8f22c8cff.png by default.
If you need to use a generated image at another path, copy it and leave the original in place unless the user explicitly asks you to delete it.
The generated image is already displayed to the user. There is no need to render it in the final response as a Markdown image or file link.
